newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSAPANK AND HOIUPANK DOMINATE MODERATE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: HANSAPANK AND HOIUPANK DOMINATE MODERATE TRADE.

text.p: The Estonian stock exchange saw
moderately active trade on Monday with Hoiupank and Hansapank
the leading stocks.
Total trade on the main list was 41.5 million kroons with
the Talse 0.17 percent down at 251.41.
Hoiupank turned over 18.1 million kroons to close 0.40
kroons lower on 131.85 kroons.
"Hoiupank had very good results and there was local and
foreign interest active in both buying and selling," another
trader said.
Hansapank was stable on 130.85 kroons on trade worth 16.2
million kroons.
"Trade in Hansa today was supported by mixed interest with
both foreigner and locals active," he added.
"There were some larger blocks traded in Hansa to help the
volume along," another dealer said.
The free market turned over 0.5 million kroons with
privatisation vouchers most active on 190,249 kroons to stay
stable on 0.271 kroons.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom, +372 620 9202/1
reuters@reuters.ee
